sections.heading: The Need
sections.text: Solace Harbor's astronomy collective lacks accessible telescopes and educational resources, hindering community engagement with the night sky.

sections.heading: Our Plan
sections.text: We aim to establish a telescope library and offer illustrated workshops, fostering a sense of wonder and knowledge among residents.

sections.heading: Your Impact
sections.text: Support will enable us to purchase telescopes, develop educational materials, and host workshops, making astronomy accessible to all in Solace Harbor.
